methods.title: Closed Noetic Representation accounting and rate budget

laws.statement: Every persistent representation part and external dependency is billed against the original logical-weight denominator; an open dependency withholds runnable-NR and complete-EBPW claims.

methods.claim_boundary: The contract proves how Hawking charges a representation and refuses an open NR runnable claim. The Flash receipt is a source-control and target-budget baseline only; it does not establish a compact full-body representation, capability, direct full-body execution, or TPS.
methods.reopen_if: A representation needs a previously unmodelled persistent decoder/state class, or a target architecture uses a non-scalar denominator that cannot be mapped to original logical weights.

methods.title: Stateful repeated accepted decode
methods.claim_boundary: Proves repeated accepted stateful decode for the named Flash source-bound controls. It neither establishes a warm resident whole-model TPS result nor transfers state semantics to another architecture without that architecture's own reference-bound control.
methods.reopen_if: A target model exposes a different state representation or cannot preserve an independently checked sequence without a source reset.

methods.title: Teacher-bound routed-expert union compaction
methods.claim_boundary: The Flash route union is an exact teacher-bound representation control. It is not a live-routing capability result, a whole-model complete-EBPW result, or a TPS claim.
methods.reopen_if: A target MoE has a different routing contract, inaccessible expert rows, or its measured route union does not offer sufficient active-byte reduction.

methods.title: Release immutable source weights after device upload
methods.claim_boundary: Flash controls demonstrate release of the measured linear source tensors and all twelve full-attention source tensors after Metal upload. Linear banks remain process-lifetime resident; full-attention banks are reused across their layer-major token pass, not yet across a token-major whole body. This is not a complete long-lived resident model or warm-token TPS result.
methods.reopen_if: A target has an immutable weight owner that cannot be released after upload, retains hidden host copies during its token loop, or requires a different lifetime to obtain a fair warm-token measurement.

methods.title: Device-resident state handoff between execution organs
methods.claim_boundary: Proves a no-host-snapshot device handoff across the recorded Flash chain. It does not by itself prove repeated state continuity, complete-model residency, or streaming TPS.
methods.reopen_if: A target organ boundary requires host-visible state, has incompatible layouts, or a repeated token control exposes state drift.

methods.title: Sealed source-activation representation rate--distortion screen
methods.claim_boundary: The method binds a selected source activation to a small matrix representation screen and exposes executed matvec distortion without laundering the teacher vector into an NR dependency. On Flash layer-0 source-selected expert 411, the best tested <=0.5 scoped point had source-activation relative-L2 0.697437. This is a negative result for the tested BF16 low-rank plus sparse-repair substrate on that control, not a full-expert, held-out, whole-model, or capability impossibility claim.
methods.reopen_if: A materially different representation adds multi-activation/held-out evidence, learned repair, a non-low-rank base, or a source-bound function objective that changes the tested information allocation.

methods.title: Held-out shared-PQ rate--distortion screen for sharded lookup tables
methods.claim_boundary: The method is a bounded, held-out row discriminator. For Flash's 128-shard n-gram table, shared PQ reaches 0.093761 projected table EBPW but has 0.964632 held-out global relative-L2; the best tested <=0.5 projected point is 0.375011 EBPW with 0.847257 error. This rejects uniform global PQ as an escalation candidate at those tested rates. It does not establish full-table lookup semantics, active-token fidelity, direct execution, complete NR EBPW, or capability.
methods.reopen_if: A source PLE output/hidden-state control paired with an actual lookup-access trace justifies selective hot-row repair, a learned/generative representation, a different source distribution, or a non-uniform/shared-hierarchy representation that changes the tested hypothesis.

methods.title: Function-aware global-PQ plus fixed sparse-repair screen for PLE lookup tables

laws.statement: For the sealed Flash BOS PLE control, uniformly shared PQ plus fixed per-row local-error BF16 repair remains grossly distortive below 1.0 projected table EBPW. Do not re-invoke that exact composition on Flash; reopen only with a materially different function, hierarchy, or learned repair allocation.

adapters.verifier: sealed JSON receipt: source PLE PQ plus sparse-repair screen

methods.claim_boundary: For one sealed, independently reference-checked Flash BOS PLE formula control, this method bills a projected full 320,001,536-row table and applies its exact encoded representation to the 16 active source rows. The best tested <=0.5 point is 0.487511 projected table EBPW (d16/k8 plus two repaired BF16 entries/row) but its PLE output has 0.850550 relative-L2 and 0.538099 cosine; the best <=1.0 point remains 0.727215 relative-L2. This rejects that exact uniform-PQ plus fixed local-error repair composition from broader escalation at the tested rates. It does not establish PLE irreducibility, a materialized table, broader state behavior, a native compact runtime, complete NR EBPW, or capability.
methods.reopen_if: A materially different function representation changes the information allocation: state-conditioned or generated rows, output-aware/learned residual allocation, a learned PLE replacement, a different hierarchy, or Nova repair. A target without the required source PLE output and reference-parity controls must not select this method.

methods.title: Function-aware physical-shard-local PQ screen for PLE lookup tables

laws.statement: For the sealed Flash BOS PLE control, independently fitted BF16 PQ codebooks for the 128 physical PLE shards do not yield a useful sub-one function curve. At <=0.5 projected table EBPW, the best tested local point is 0.375062 EBPW with 0.859731 PLE-output relative-L2, worse than the already-billed global-plus-fixed-repair point at 0.487511 EBPW and 0.850550 relative-L2. Do not re-invoke this fixed shard-local PQ family; reopen only with a hierarchy that changes the function or information allocation.

adapters.verifier: sealed JSON receipt: source PLE physical-shard-local PQ screen

methods.claim_boundary: For one sealed reference-checked Flash BOS PLE formula control, this method keeps deterministic train/held-out rows inside their exact numeric source shard, bills 128 separately fitted BF16 PQ codebook families and every projected table code, and applies the local codebook selected by each of the 16 active source rows. Its best <=0.5 point is 0.375062 projected table EBPW with 0.859731 PLE-output relative-L2; the d8/k16 point is 0.500113 EBPW with 0.816312 error and is still grossly distortive. This rejects the fixed physical-shard-local PQ family from broader escalation. It does not reject other hierarchical, state-conditioned, generated, learned, or Nova PLE functions, nor establish a materialized table, direct execution, full PLE state behavior, complete NR EBPW, or capability.
methods.reopen_if: A materially different hierarchy changes the local representation rather than merely rerunning fixed BF16 PQ: cross-shard learned bases or residuals, context-conditioned codebooks, output-aware learned allocation, generated rows, a learned PLE replacement, or Nova repair. A target without source PLE output and reference-parity controls must not select this method.

methods.title: Function-aware greedy additive residual-PQ screen for PLE lookup tables

laws.statement: For the sealed Flash BOS PLE control, two greedily decoded BF16 residual-PQ stages do not provide a useful sub-one PLE function curve. The best <=0.5 point is 0.400011 projected table EBPW with 0.861647 PLE-output relative-L2, worse than the existing 0.487511 global-plus-fixed-repair point at 0.850550; the d8/k4 two-stage point is 0.500011 EBPW with 0.814410 error and remains grossly distortive. Do not re-invoke this fixed greedy additive-PQ family; reopen only with a materially different learned/contextual function or allocation.

The best <=0.5 point is 0.400011 projected table EBPW with 0.861647 PLE-output relative-L2; it is not a source-control survivor. This rejects the fixed greedy two-stage additive construction, not jointly trained/additive, context-conditioned, generated, learned, or Nova PLE functions, nor a materialized table, direct execution, full PLE state behavior, complete NR EBPW, or capability.

A target without source PLE output and reference-parity controls must not select this method.

methods.title: Address-conditioned generated-row discriminator for PLE lookup tables

laws.statement: For the sealed Flash BOS PLE control, a smooth address-only Fourier generator has no usable held-out row or PLE-output fidelity. Do not re-invoke smooth address-only variants on Flash; reopen only with token/history conditioning, hierarchy, learned routing, or Nova repair.

methods.title: Source-bound discontinuous additive-hash PLE row-function screen

laws.statement: For Flash's sealed BOS PLE control, a discontinuous three-term additive-hash address-factor generator reaches only 0.979713 PLE-output relative-L2 at its best tested point (64 buckets, 0.000010330 projected table EBPW), while its held-out row relative-L2 is 1.095700. Do not retry fixed address-only hash mixing or bucket sweeps; the tested factor family does not preserve useful table function.

The best tested candidate is exceptionally small as a projected table description but fails both held-out row and PLE-output fidelity. It rejects this fixed discontinuous address-only factor prior, not context/history-conditioned functions, hierarchical/generative expert mechanisms, a materialized artifact, direct execution, complete NR EBPW, or capability.

methods.title: Source-bound address/context PLE tangent-geometry screen

laws.statement: For Flash's sealed BOS PLE control, the exact zero-history formula responds through a compact spectrum over the declared eight-direction synthetic local plane (cross-address rank 6 at 90% energy), but that plane is not a source trajectory distribution. Do not claim a context-conditioned PLE replacement, stateful fidelity, complete EBPW, or capability from it; require a real source multi-context state bank before learned function training.

methods.claim_boundary: For Flash's sealed BOS PLE source formula control, this method first proves a zero-history batch form reproduces the exact sealed injection, then probes eight real hashed addresses over a deterministic eight-direction synthetic local context plane. It measured cross-address response rank 6 at 90% energy, 7 at 95%, and 10 at 99%. The historical stateful-session receipt that supplies the address sequence has a valid native compact-UTF8 seal and is bound as accepted-session provenance only. It still does not contain PLE-inclusive source-model states, so this screen is not a real source-state bank, learned function, representation, direct execution, complete EBPW, capability, or TPS result.

Then train/evaluate a materially new (address, context, persistent PLE state) contribution function under held-out functional and capability gates. A changed PLE formula/address contract also requires a new tangent screen.

methods.title: Source-bound native-context PLE formula bank

latest_attempt.observed_error: Complete 48-layer forward predicted token 271 where the supplied first continuation token was 2972.
latest_attempt.interpretation: A real source-bound seven-slot state bank was captured in one native process, but the session did not earn the accepted-continuation contract. The bank is diagnostic only and cannot feed the formula-bank adapter as an accepted stateful control.
latest_attempt.reopen_condition: Rerun the pinned source-bound session with the recorded preceding argmax token 271, then continue with the next independently recorded argmax and require at least two accepted generation tokens. Do not synthesize acceptance from the captured bank.

laws.statement: A real stateful native context bank is stronger than a synthetic tangent plane, but its current Flash native body omits PLE. Formula outputs over that bank may train or falsify a conditional contribution function, never establish upstream PLE-inclusive trajectory parity, a compact representation, capability, or TPS by themselves.

Fit only a materially distinct address/context/history-conditioned contribution candidate and test it on disjoint native contexts. methods.title: Source-bound PLE n-gram token-to-row access trace
methods.claim_boundary: For Flash's pinned Qwen4-Exp PLE configuration, this method binds the 16 EOS-aware hashed lookup rows per accepted token to real concatenated checkpoint rows. It does not execute PLE projections, gates, norms, convolution, hidden-state inputs, direct lookup runtime, complete EBPW, or capability.

methods.claim_boundary: For the sealed Flash BOS pre-layer state, this method evaluates the documented PLE formula with exact source BF16 lookup rows and support payloads, emits a post-injection state and the persistent PLE convolution state, and matches the pinned Transformers PLE implementation within 4.47e-8 max-abs / 1.50e-7 relative-L2. It remains one control, not full checkpoint forward parity, a native PLE runtime, repeated token proof, full Flash fidelity, complete NR EBPW, TPS, or capability.

Escalate to a complete token graph only after direct PLE execution and broader output comparison are available.

methods.title: Reference-framework PLE formula parity oracle
methods.claim_boundary: The oracle validates the canonical PLE formula against the pinned Transformers PLE layer while substituting an exact source-row embedding for the uninstantiated giant lookup table. It does not validate source model loading, later layer behavior, native runtime, repeated state, complete NR EBPW, TPS, or capability.

methods.title: Route-major direct packed Q4 routed-MoE execution
methods.claim_boundary: The named Flash discriminator proves a direct Q4/G64 route-major MoE primitive: ten selected gate/up launches and ten route-aware down launches become two device-chained launches with deterministic candidate-body output parity. The sealed layer-0 bridge binds the actual source MLP activation and all ten source-selected routes to persisted Q4/G64 bodies without a source-tensor or source-weight read in candidate execution. On that control, Q4 candidate GPU-to-CPU parity passes while the source-BF16 routed-sum difference is measured at cosine 0.995096, RMSE 0.001571, and max absolute error 0.005515; it has no declared capability threshold. This does not establish source-BF16 output parity, a native weighted-sum kernel, complete EBPW, complete-layer/token performance, or qualified model TPS.
methods.reopen_if: A target uses incompatible route-specific activations, non-Q4/G64 body layout, a different group-aligned column geometry, lacks source-route body coverage, cannot seal an exact source activation/route/routed-sum control, or requires a declared capability threshold for its measured source-output distortion.
